text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As part of her self-promotion efforts, Curren Chan decides to do an interview for a website. She seems to have some prior experience with the reporter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The interview starts with a barrage of impolite questions seemingly aimed at making her confess that she's only racing for the attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Curren Chan flat out denies the accusation that she's just messing around. She also speaks seriously about her feelings toward racing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, she captivates the interviewer and makes him admit she is cute. When the article is posted a few days later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan's feelings resonate with everyone, and she is successful in changing the minds of many who thought she wasn't taking running seriously.
